entries.wording: Nettbutikken har meldt at en pakke er på vei!
entries.note: The shop announced the parcel; Helthjem does not have it yet.

entries.wording: Vi har mottatt pakken din, og gjør den klar for veien videre.
entries.note: Received at a Helthjem terminal, which the scan names.
A terminal or sorter scan. The page hides the rows of its sorter, which it names VestbySorter; the adapter keeps them.

Booked on the coming night's round, the day before it: no courier has the parcel yet. The wording names that night's date, which the adapter reads as the expected delivery day. Helthjem files the scan as delivering; its code overrides that state, for the parcel too while it is the newest scan in that state.

entries.wording: Budet fikk ikke med seg pakken din ut i natt.
entries.note: The night's courier did not take the parcel out, so it waits for a later round. Helthjem files the scan as delivering; its code overrides that state, for the parcel too while it is the newest scan.

entries.wording: Pakken er levert på dørmatten din!
Pakken er levert i postkassen din!
